result.note: Brief trade item; tests the regulatory theme (antimicrobial resistance) behind India's continued EU market access for animal-origin food.

questions.prompt: In June 2026, India secured continued access to the European Union market for animal-origin food exports after clearing tightened EU rules relating to which of the following?
questions.explain: India cleared the EU's tightened antimicrobial-resistance rules, which kept its animal-origin food exports eligible for the EU market. The outcome protected Indian fishery exports worth USD 1.59 billion.
questions.source: clearing tightened antimicrobial-resistance rules and protecting fishery exports worth USD 1.59 billion
